scope: Bahia web operations widget ingestion, trust configuration, navigation, and Wheelhouse rendering.
intended_behavior: The web UI maintains a recovering kind-30318 subscription on only the Wheelhouse fleet relays.
Inbound events pass Bahia signature validation and a fail-closed publisher allowlist before entering Wheelhouse latest-by-slot storage.
The Ops Widgets route delegates envelope validation, template selection, ECharts options, tables, data_ref placeholders, and fallback cards to Wheelhouse.
Operators can configure trusted widget publisher pubkeys through PUBLIC_WHEELHOUSE_ALLOWED_PUBKEYS.
out_of_scope: Fetching data_ref sidecars without Wheelhouse's future verified-sidecar implementation
